meta.game: Final Fantasy Tactics: The Ivalice Chronicles (2025). War of the Lions (2007) values where TIC is not published.
notes: JP costs: Game8 and RPGSite (they agree with each other). Hack the Minotaur contradicts itself between pages and is only noted where it differs.
Ability names are the TIC names. 'fft' gives the PS1 name and the FFT effect, 'description' the BG3 effect implemented in the stats drafts.
Abilities with no good BG3 equivalent yet are listed in 'leftOut' with their costs.
Pages were read through web-search summaries (the cloud network blocks the sites); re-check numbers against the in-game Job menu if they matter.

sources.tic_game_data: FFT: The Ivalice Chronicles game data (vanilla Enhanced nex tables 'Ability' and 'GeneralJob', read with FF16Tools 1.13.3 on the user's PC, 2026-10-12)

jobLevels.note: Total JP earned for job levels 2-8. TIC uses the WotL table (PS1 US was lower, e.g. Lv3 350, Lv4 550).

jpFormula.enhancedBonus: TIC Enhanced: +30% JP from the unit's own actions, applied after the formula, not to spillover or proposition JP
jpFormula.spillover: allies on the field get 1/4 of the JP an ally earns, in that ally's job, before JP Boost; in TIC also into jobs they have not unlocked
jpFormula.uncertain: fan analysis suggests the TIC constant may be 16 instead of 8

jobs.name: Chemist
jobs.description: Item expert. Starting job. Throws items when it is the primary job.

jobs.name: Knight
jobs.description: Breaks the enemy's armor, weapon, speed and power.

jobs.name: Bard
jobs.note: Male only in FFT; the lock is not used in BG3.

jobs.name: Dancer
jobs.note: Female only in FFT; the lock is not used in BG3.

abilities.name: Focus
abilities.description: Bonus action. +1 to attack rolls and +1 damage for 10 turns.
abilities.fft: PS1 Accumulate: Physical Attack +1 for the battle.
abilities.note: Hack the Minotaur: 300 on one page, 400 on another.

abilities.name: Rush
abilities.description: Melee weapon attack that also pushes the target 2 m.

abilities.name: Throw Stone
abilities.description: Throw a stone at a target up to 18 m away: 1d6 bludgeoning and a 1 m push.
abilities.fft: PS1 Throw Stone: ranged damage and knockback.

abilities.name: Salve
abilities.description: Touch an ally to end Blinded, Poisoned and Silenced.
abilities.fft: PS1 Heal: cures Blind, Silence, Poison.

abilities.name: Counter Tackle
abilities.description: When a melee attack hits you, the attacker takes 1d4 bludgeoning damage and is pushed 1.5 m.
abilities.fft: Counters a melee hit with Rush.

abilities.name: Equip Axes
abilities.description: Proficiency with handaxes, battleaxes and greataxes.

abilities.name: Evasive Stance
abilities.description: Adds the Defend bonus action: +2 AC until your next turn.
abilities.fft: PS1 Defend: adds the Defend command (evasion up until next turn).

abilities.name: JP Boost
abilities.description: Earn 50% more JP.
abilities.fft: PS1 Gained JP Up: JP x1.5. TIC cost 250 (PS1 200).

abilities.name: Movement +1
abilities.description: +3 m movement speed.

abilities.name: Potion
abilities.description: Heal 2d4+2. Touch range, or 9 m when thrown (Chemist primary job or Throw Items).

abilities.name: Hi-Potion
abilities.description: Heal 4d4+4. Once per short rest. Thrown like Potion.

abilities.name: X-Potion
abilities.description: Heal 8d4+8. Once per long rest. Thrown like Potion.

abilities.name: Ether
abilities.description: The target regains one level 1 spell slot. Once per long rest. Thrown like Potion.

abilities.name: Elixir
abilities.description: Fully heal the target and restore one level 2 spell slot. Once per long rest. Thrown like Potion.

abilities.name: Antidote
abilities.description: End Poisoned. Thrown like Potion.

abilities.name: Eye Drops
abilities.description: End Blinded. Thrown like Potion.

abilities.name: Echo Herbs
abilities.description: End Silenced. Thrown like Potion.

abilities.name: Remedy
abilities.description: End Poisoned, Blinded, Silenced and Frightened. Once per short rest. Thrown like Potion.

abilities.name: Phoenix Down
abilities.description: Revive a dead ally with 1 HP. Once per short rest. Thrown like Potion.

abilities.name: Auto-Potion
abilities.description: When you take damage, regain 1d4+2 HP. Once per turn.
abilities.fft: Uses the weakest potion in the inventory when hit.

abilities.name: Throw Items
abilities.description: Item abilities can be thrown up to 9 m with any job.
abilities.fft: Allows throwing items from any job.

abilities.name: Treasure Hunter
abilities.description: +2 to Perception (spot hidden items and traps).
abilities.fft: PS1 Move-Find Item: find items hidden on tiles.
abilities.note: Hack the Minotaur: 100 on its ability page, 200 in its table.

abilities.name: Rend Armor
abilities.description: Melee weapon attack that deals no damage; on a hit the target has -2 AC for 3 turns.
abilities.fft: PS1 Armor Break: destroys body armor.

abilities.name: Rend Weapon
abilities.description: Melee weapon attack that deals no damage; on a hit the target has disadvantage on attack rolls for 2 turns.
abilities.fft: PS1 Weapon Break: destroys the weapon.
abilities.note: RPGSite leaves the cost blank; Hack the Minotaur: 300 (400 on its own Rend Weapon page).

abilities.name: Rend Speed
abilities.description: Melee weapon attack that deals no damage; on a hit the target has -3 m movement for 3 turns.

abilities.name: Rend Power
abilities.description: Melee weapon attack that deals no damage; on a hit the target deals 2 less damage for 3 turns.
abilities.fft: PS1 Power Break: lowers Physical Attack.

abilities.name: Rend Magick
abilities.description: Melee weapon attack that deals no damage; on a hit the target has -2 spell save DC and -2 to spell attack rolls for 3 turns.
abilities.fft: PS1 Mind Break: lowers Magic Attack.

abilities.name: Parry
abilities.description: Slashing, piercing and bludgeoning damage you take is reduced by 2.
abilities.fft: PS1 Weapon Guard: block attacks with the weapon.

abilities.name: Equip Heavy Armor
abilities.description: Proficiency with medium and heavy armour.

abilities.name: Equip Shields
abilities.description: Proficiency with shields.

abilities.name: Equip Swords
abilities.description: Proficiency with shortswords, longswords and greatswords.

abilities.name: Aim +1
abilities.description: Ranged weapon attack that deals 1d4 extra damage.
abilities.fft: PS1 Charge+1: charged shot, more damage after a short delay.

abilities.name: Aim +2
abilities.description: Ranged weapon attack that deals 1d6 extra damage.

abilities.name: Aim +3
abilities.description: Ranged weapon attack that deals 1d8 extra damage.

abilities.name: Aim +4
abilities.description: Ranged weapon attack that deals 2d6 extra damage.

abilities.name: Aim +5
abilities.description: Costs your action and bonus action. Ranged weapon attack that deals 2d8 extra damage.

abilities.name: Aim +7
abilities.description: Costs your action and bonus action. Ranged weapon attack that deals 3d8 extra damage. Once per short rest.

abilities.name: Aim +10
abilities.description: Costs your action and bonus action. Ranged weapon attack that deals 4d10 extra damage. Once per short rest.

abilities.name: Aim +20
abilities.description: Costs your action and bonus action. Ranged weapon attack that deals 8d10 extra damage. Once per long rest.

abilities.name: Speed Surge
abilities.description: When you take damage, gain +3 m movement for 2 turns.
abilities.fft: PS1 Speed Save: Speed +1 when hit.
abilities.note: Hack the Minotaur lists Adrenaline Rush (400) instead.

abilities.name: Archer's Bane
abilities.description: Piercing damage you take is reduced by 3.
abilities.fft: PS1 Arrow Guard: evade arrows and bolts.

abilities.name: Equip Crossbows
abilities.description: Proficiency with hand, light and heavy crossbows.

abilities.name: Concentration
abilities.description: +2 to weapon attack rolls.
abilities.fft: PS1 Concentrate: ignores the target's evasion.

abilities.name: Jump +1
abilities.description: +3 m jump distance.

abilities.name: Cure
abilities.description: Heal a creature within 18 m for 1d8+3. Once per turn.
abilities.fft: Restores HP in a small area.

abilities.name: Cura
abilities.description: Heal up to 3 allies for 2d8+3. Once per short rest.

abilities.name: Curaga
abilities.description: Heal up to 4 allies for 4d8+4. Once per long rest.

abilities.name: Raise
abilities.description: Revive a dead ally with 1 HP. Once per short rest.
abilities.fft: Revives a KO'd unit with some HP.

abilities.name: Arise
abilities.description: Revive a dead ally and heal it for 4d8. Once per long rest.
abilities.fft: PS1 Raise 2: revives with full HP.

abilities.name: Reraise
abilities.description: Death Ward: the next time the ally would drop to 0 HP, it drops to 1 HP instead. Once per long rest.

abilities.name: Regen
abilities.description: The target regains 1d4+1 HP at the start of each of its turns for 5 turns. Once per turn.
abilities.note: RPGSite does not list it; Hack the Minotaur: 70 or 80.

abilities.name: Protect
abilities.description: The target gets +2 AC for 5 turns. Once per turn.

abilities.name: Shell
abilities.description: The target has advantage on saving throws against spells for 5 turns. Once per turn.

abilities.name: Esuna
abilities.description: End Poisoned, Blinded, Silenced and Frightened on a creature within 18 m. Once per turn.
abilities.fft: Cures status ailments in an area.

abilities.name: Holy
abilities.description: 4d10 radiant damage to a creature within 18 m, no attack roll. Once per short rest.

abilities.name: Regenerate
abilities.description: When you take damage, you gain Regen for 3 turns (1d4+1 HP per turn) unless you already have it.

abilities.name: Magick Defense Boost
abilities.description: +1 to all saving throws.
abilities.fft: PS1 Magic DefendUP: reduces magic damage taken.

abilities.name: Fire

abilities.name: Fira

abilities.name: Firaga
abilities.description: 6d6 fire damage in a 4.5 m radius; Dexterity save for half. Once per long rest.

abilities.name: Thunder
abilities.description: 1d8 lightning damage to a creature within 18 m, no attack roll.

abilities.name: Thundara
abilities.description: 3d6 lightning damage in a 3 m radius; Dexterity save for half. Once per short rest.

abilities.name: Thundaga
abilities.description: 6d6 lightning damage in a 4.5 m radius; Dexterity save for half. Once per long rest.

abilities.name: Blizzard
abilities.description: 1d8 cold damage to a creature within 18 m, no attack roll.

abilities.description: 3d6 cold damage in a 3 m radius; Dexterity save for half. Once per short rest.

abilities.name: Blizzaga

abilities.name: Magick Counter
